summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive $8.8B in SPX BuyCalls versus only $2B in BuyPuts. Significant directional conviction is seen in the massive accumulation of SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) and 7000C (exp 2027-03-19), totaling billions in premium, alongside heavy hedging via SPX 8000P contracts. Persistent multi-day interest is undeniable, with over $7B in SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) and $2.4B in SPX 8000P (exp 2026-12-18) accumulating over the last 5 sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in SPX and NDX, but monitor for any reversal signals as the high P/C ratio in QQQ (3.29) and NDXP (3.48) suggests growing short-term defensive hedging in the tech-heavy indices.
